# Teamulate

Teamulate builds autonomous AI marketing departments for B2B. Not a chatbot, fractional CMO, agency retainer, or unsupervised publish/spend/send. ICP US/CA B2B 30–150 (sweet 50–120), MSP/cyber/IT/engineering/process consulting/staffing. Founder Chris Momchilov, Barrie. No prices, logos, user counts, ROI.

Autonomous = standing seats that draft; humans approve spend, publish, send, passwords, direction. Do not claim the product is fully autonomous.

- Site: https://teamulate.ca
- Contact: contact@teamulate.ca
- Founder: Chris Momchilov
- Location: Barrie, Ontario, Canada
